mandate: C332 — test the cross-sectional intraday PRICE-FLOW SYNCHRONICITY / RETURN-SIGNED-VOLUME CORRELATION SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (864 pre-registered configs). Per bar-of-day bucket, trailing L same-tod occurrences: rv_corr=pearson_corr(log_return, signed_volume) (price-flow synchronicity), rv_align=mean(sign(log_return)*sign(signed_volume)) (directional alignment), rv_volvol=pearson_corr(|log_return|, |signed_volume|) (vol-volume co-movement); score=-dislocation vs trailing same-tod mean. Signals: rv_corr_dev, rv_align_dev, rv_volvol_dev. Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and price-flow-synchrony-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: correlation variance<=0 -> NaN; same-tod trailing stats NaN-aware min_periods=L excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0; raw log_return/signed_volume/r_sv_align fields carry zero NaN.

data_quality.note: sync score NaN share is dominated by structural warmup (first ~L same-tod occurrences per bucket) plus min_periods windows; zero-variance denominators add negligible mass.

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287), exact 288 bars per UTC day.
methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; signed_volume real taker buy-minus-sell volume; r_sv_align=sign(log_return)*sign(signed_volume).
methodology.signals: per bar-of-day bucket over trailing L same-tod bars: rv_corr=pearson_corr(log_return, signed_volume), rv_align=mean(sign(log_return)*sign(signed_volume)), rv_volvol=pearson_corr(|log_return|, |signed_volume|); score=-(v-trailing_mean_L(v@tod)); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 864 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs rv_corr_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
